labelling.rule: 3 Heat Extreme Core = highest mean total SHAP; 1 Riparian Buffer = most negative mean SHAP(frac_water)+SHAP(ndwi) among the other three (fallback: highest mean frac_water); 0 Ecological Cool Base = lower mean total SHAP of the last two; 2 Transition = the last one

clusters.name: Ecological Cool Base
clusters.reason: lower mean total SHAP of the last two clusters

clusters.name: Riparian Buffer
clusters.reason: most negative mean SHAP(frac_water) + SHAP(ndwi) among the non-hottest clusters

zones.name: Ecological Cool Base
zones.description: Ecological Cool Base: 27,287 km² in 2025 (41% of the study area), mean observed LST 40.3 °C. Main warming drivers: Night-time lights (+0.03 °C), Water (+0.03 °C). Main cooling drivers: NDVI (-1.01 °C), NDBI (-0.09 °C), Impervious cover (-0.07 °C). Largest shares in Alwar (11%), Jind (8%), Muzaffarnagar (8%).

recommendations.rationale: In the final model, raising tree cover by 15 percentage points in every cell (zone median 0% → 15%) is associated with a mean LST change of -0.49 °C over the zone's 27,287 cells (95% CI -0.54 to -0.44 °C). The land is taken from the other land covers (including other vegetation) in proportion to their shares, mostly cropland (-12 pp) and other vegetation (-1.8 pp); NDVI, NDWI and NDBI follow through the land-cover coupling. This is a model-based ceteris-paribus estimate, not a causal effect. The target is the feasibility bound (the zone's own 90th/10th percentile, or the maximum step).

In the final model, raising NDVI by 0.05 in every cell (zone median 0.26 → 0.31), i.e. greening within the existing land covers is associated with a mean LST change of -0.37 °C over the zone's 27,249 cells (95% CI -0.41 to -0.33 °C). This is a model-based ceteris-paribus estimate, not a causal effect. The target is the smallest step that achieves ≥ 90% of the cooling available within the feasibility bounds.

In the final model, lowering cropland by 20 percentage points in every cell (zone median 93% → 73%) is associated with a mean LST change of -0.10 °C over the zone's 27,287 cells (95% CI -0.18 to -0.02 °C). The land is given to the other land covers (including other vegetation) in proportion to their shares, mostly impervious cover (+6.5 pp) and other vegetation (+6.1 pp); NDVI, NDWI and NDBI follow through the land-cover coupling. This is a model-based ceteris-paribus estimate, not a causal effect. The target is the feasibility bound (the zone's own 90th/10th percentile, or the maximum step).
